# Aerial Care Coordination

> Support and resources for Aerial Care Coordination users to access technical assistance and customer support.

Aerial Care Coordination, powered by MeDecision, provides care coordination solutions with dedicated support channels for users. The Aerial Community Support team offers assistance through multiple contact methods and help resources.

## Key Topics

- Aerial Care Coordination
- MeDecision
- Aerial Community Support
- Technical Assistance
- Customer Support
- Contact Support
- Help Resources
- Support Phone

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Support](https://aerial.carecoordination.medecision.com/contactus.html): Contact page for Aerial Care Coordination support and technical assistance
